name: Knowledge gap
definition: A materially relevant question for which adequate published investigation was not found

name: Evidence gap
definition: A topic with claims or proposals but insufficient empirical validation

name: Comparison gap
definition: Competing methods exist without a sufficiently controlled common evaluation

name: Cross-layer gap
definition: Mature components or research streams have not been adequately studied together

name: Trade-off gap
definition: Competing objectives are recognized but their achievable trade-off boundary remains insufficiently characterized

name: Reproducibility gap
definition: Published evidence cannot be adequately reproduced from available artifacts and methodological detail

name: Standards/deployment gap
definition: Research assumptions or solutions are insufficiently connected to standards or real deployment constraints
